Rhode Island: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Rhode Island on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 4, 2026. Rhode Island's rule is 30 days before the election. We could not confirm this date with an official source. Check with the Secretary of State.
  • Last day to apply for a mail ballot: October 13, 2026. Rhode Island's rule is 21 days before the election. We could not confirm this date with an official source.
  • Early in-person voting: October 14, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Usually at your city or town hall during business hours. We worked out these dates from state rules and could not confirm them with an official source.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are normally open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Official election information: vote.gov

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Governor

A four-year term. This is an open seat because Gov. Dan McKee lost the Democratic primary. The lieutenant governor is elected separately, not on a joint ticket.
